fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects DNS queries made by "AppInstaller.EXE". The AppInstaller is the default handler for the "ms-appinstaller" URI. It attempts to load/install a package from the referenced URL
fields.name: AppX Package Installation Attempts Via AppInstaller.EXE
fields.query: event.category="dns" and (endpoint.os="windows" and (src.process.image.path contains "C:\\Program Files\\WindowsApps\\Microsoft.DesktopAppInstaller_" and src.process.image.path contains "\\AppInstaller.exe"))
